examples.question_text: A reducing balance loan of $\$8000$ is fully repaid by $30$ equal monthly repayments of $\$320$. Find the total amount repaid and the total interest paid.
A loan of $\$200\,000$ can be cleared by equal monthly repayments of $\$1600$ over $20$ years, or equal fortnightly repayments of $\$800$ over $17$ years. Find the difference in total interest paid.
examples.solution_text:
Monthly repayments:
$\begin{align*}\text{Total repaid} &=1600\times12\times20\\&=\$384\,000\\\text{Interest} &=384\,000-200\,000\\&=\$184\,000\end{align*}$
Fortnightly repayments:
$\begin{align*}\text{Total repaid} &=800\times26\times17\\&=\$353\,600\\\text{Interest} &=353\,600-200\,000\\&=\$153\,600\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}\text{Interest saving} &=184\,000-153\,600\\&=\$30\,400\end{align*}$

examples.question_text: A loan of $\$90\,000$ is scheduled to be cleared by equal monthly repayments of $\$800$ over $15$ years. After $4$ years, the borrower pays a lump sum of $\$20\,000$ and continues paying $\$800$ per month. The loan is cleared after a further $96$ equal monthly repayments. Find the overall saving and how many months earlier the loan is cleared.
examples.solution_text:
Without the lump sum:
$\begin{align*}\text{Number of repayments} &=15\times12=180\\\text{Total repaid} &=800\times180\\&=\$144\,000\end{align*}$
With the lump sum, include repayments made before and after the extra payment:
$\begin{align*}\text{Number of repayments} &=4\times12+96\\&=144\\\text{Total repaid} &=800\times144+20\,000\\&=\$135\,200\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}\text{Saving} &=144\,000-135\,200\\&=\$8800\\\text{Term reduction} &=180-144\\&=36\text{ months}\end{align*}$

examples.question_text: A loan of $\$30\,000$ can be cleared by $90$ equal monthly repayments of $\$450$. Increasing the monthly repayment to $\$500$ clears it in $78$ equal repayments. Find the overall saving.
examples.solution_text:
At $\$450$ per month:
$\begin{align*}\text{Total repaid} &=450\times90\\&=\$40\,500\end{align*}$
At $\$500$ per month:
$\begin{align*}\text{Total repaid} &=500\times78\\&=\$39\,000\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}\text{Saving} &=40\,500-39\,000\\&=\$1500\end{align*}$

Read where each curve meets the horizontal axis. The solid blue curve gives about $110$ months; the dashed red curve gives about $50$ months.
At $\$450$ per month:
$\begin{align*}\text{Estimated total} &=450\times110\\&=\$49\,500\end{align*}$
At $\$750$ per month:
$\begin{align*}\text{Estimated total} &=750\times50\\&=\$37\,500\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}\text{Estimated saving} &=49\,500-37\,500\\&=\$12\,000\end{align*}$

examples.question_text: A reducing balance loan of $\$10\,000$ charges interest at $9\%$ p.a., compounded monthly. Repayments of $\$400$ are made at the end of each month, starting one month after borrowing. Find the balance immediately after the second repayment. Round each month's interest to the nearest cent.
examples.solution_text:
$\text{Monthly rate}=\dfrac{0.09}{12}=0.0075$
Month 1:
$\begin{align*}\text{Interest} &=10\,000\times0.0075\\&=\$75.00\\\text{Ending balance} &=10\,000+75-400\\&=\$9675.00\end{align*}$
Use this ending balance as the next month's starting balance.
Month 2:
$\begin{align*}\text{Interest} &=9675\times0.0075\\&=72.5625\\&\approx\$72.56\\\text{Ending balance} &=9675+72.56-400\\&=\$9347.56\end{align*}$
